title: Membership POS presentation request + response
description: Validates the off-register POS verification exchange against the membership credential. The request mirrors the inputs to Sorcha.Verifier PresentationRequestBuilder.CreateAsync; the response is the verifier outcome carrying ONLY the disclosed memberNumber + tier.

request.description: POS verifier inputs. requiredClaims must be a subset of the credential's disclosable claims; identity claims must NOT appear here (they stay withheld).

response.description: Verifier outcome. claims carries the disclosed subset only. identitySuppressed records the claims that were present in the credential but never requested.

identitySuppressed.description: Claims withheld by the holder because the POS never requested them.
